=== Day 3: the town meeting ===
Lian: "Here's what the town needs to know to narrow the list: I am the Martyr."
Lian: "On the first night, I have given my life over for Isolde, should the town ever hang them."
Lian: "Relayed word from the Archivist, keeping the source protected: they learned that one of Greta and Edda is the Poisoner."
Lian: "I don't have hard proof on Edda yet, still—something doesn't add up there."  [case board: #92, #93, #94, #95]
Edda: "Call it kitchen sense if you want, friends—something's sour with Agnes."  [case board: #59]

Greta: "I'll put my cards on the table so the rest of you stop squinting at me: I am the Dowser."

Greta: "On day 2, in the afternoon, on the Square I sensed 0 evil among Jory, Odette, Edda."
Greta: "This morning, on the Market I sensed 0 evil among Constance and Edda."  [case board: #96, #97, #98, #99]
Constance: "For your consideration: Last night, I watched the Docks: I saw Agnes pass by."
Constance: "I concur with Edda regarding Agnes. I saw them out on the Docks last night, while I was out on my duty."  [case board: #100, #63]
Agnes: "It troubles me to say it, neighbors, yet I don't trust Constance. Constance claims to have seen me out at night, which is a lie."  [case board: #101]
Dorian: "I know everyone's going to read into my timing here, sorry, but I can't hold it back anymore: I am the Archivist."
Dorian: "The night before you arrived, I learned that one of Greta and Edda is the Poisoner."  [case board: #102, #103]
Odette: "Since we are doing public confessions today, let's get mine over with: I am the Veteran."
Odette: "Miraculously, Lian and I are of one mind regarding Edda."  [case board: #104, #105]
